title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 超越离散词元：在医学视觉-语言模型中保持数值连续性

paragraphs.en: Objective: To develop a unified vision-language model for prompt-conditioned quantitative ultrasound measurement that addresses the mismatch between continuous measurement targets and discrete token-based numerical prediction. Methods: This article presents HAD-VLM, a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion framework that combines autoregressive text generation with continuous measurement prediction within a shared backbone. Visual prompt tuning adapts the vision encoder to ultrasound images. A diffusion process predicts a five-component representation comprising caliper endpoint coordinates and measurement length. A post-processing strategy combining the proposed coordinate-length consistency mechanism with ensemble prediction is introduced to refine measurement estimates. We evaluate four echocardiographic measurement tasks on EchoNet-LVH, with additional assessments of medical question answering and X-ray vertebral measurement. Results: HAD-VLM achieves mean absolute errors of 1.36, 2.77, 3.05, and 1.16 mm for IVSd, LVIDd, LVIDs, and LVPWd, respectively, reducing errors by 21.4-37.6% relative to the Vicuna-based autoregressive baseline. It also outperforms fine-tuned Qwen3-VL and direct MLP regression across all four tasks. Medical question answering performance is preserved on the evaluated dataset. For X-ray vertebral measurement, HAD-VLM reduces mean absolute error from 11.4 to 6.7 pixels. Conclusion: Integrating autoregressive language generation with diffusion-based continuous prediction improves quantitative medical image measurement while retaining prompt-conditioned task flexibility. Significance: HAD-VLM provides a unified approach to combining language interaction with anatomically grounded numerical prediction for quantitative medical image analysis.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative measurements are essential components of clinical image interpretation. Anatomical dimensions, lesion diameters, and ventricular volumes provide objective information for diagnosis, disease characterization, and longitudinal follow-up [ 1 , 2 ] . In ultrasound (US), obtaining these measurements often requires identifying anatomical landmarks and manually positioning calipers or tracing anatomical boundaries. These procedures increase examination workload and are subject to intra- and inter-observer variability [ 3 , 4 ] . Deep learning has therefore been widely investigated to automate US measurement, with promising results in anatomical segmentation, landmark localization, and quantitative cardiac assessment [ 5 , 6 , 2 ] . Nevertheless, many existing systems operate on predefined anatomical targets and output schemas [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 定量测量是临床影像判读的重要组成部分。 解剖结构尺寸、病灶直径和心室容积为诊断、疾病特征刻画以及纵向随访提供了客观信息 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 在超声（US）中，获取这些测量值通常需要识别解剖标志点并手动放置卡尺或描记解剖边界。 这些操作增加了检查工作量，并且容易受到观察者内部及观察者之间变异性的影响 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 因此，深度学习被广泛研究用于实现超声测量的自动化，并在解剖结构分割、标志点定位和心脏定量评估方面取得了可喜的成果 [ 5 , 6 , 2 ] 。 然而，许多现有系统只能针对预定义的解剖目标和输出模式运行 [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a complementary approach by allowing image analysis tasks to be specified through natural-language instructions. Advances in biomedical visual question answering and radiology report generation demonstrate the potential of a shared vision-language backbone to support diverse image interpretation tasks [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . For quantitative US assessment, such an interface could allow a clinician to specify the desired measurement through a text prompt while sharing visual and semantic representations across related tasks. Realizing this capability, however, requires accurate numerical prediction alongside language generation.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）提供了一种互补的方法，允许通过自然语言指令来指定图像分析任务。 生物医学视觉问答和放射学报告生成的进展表明，共享的视觉语言骨干网络有潜力支持多样化的图像解释任务 [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] 。 对于定量超声评估而言，这样的接口可以让临床医生通过文本提示来指定所需的测量，同时在相关任务之间共享视觉和语义表示。 然而，要实现这一能力，需要在语言生成之外还能进行准确的数值预测。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge lies in the mismatch between continuous measurement targets and discrete token-based output modeling, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Clinically relevant quantities, such as distances and diameters, are continuous variables, whereas autoregressive VLMs typically represent numerical values as token sequences and optimize their likelihood through categorical next-token prediction. Although language models can learn numerical relationships, this objective does not explicitly account for the magnitude of numerical errors [ 13 , 14 ] . For example, depending on the tokenizer, the value ’10.1’ may be decomposed into ’10’, ’.’, and ’1’, each generated sequentially. Such a representation does not explicitly preserve numerical proximity: similar values may have different tokenizations, and token-level prediction errors do not directly reflect distances between the corresponding values. For caliper-based measurements, small perturbations in endpoint coordinates should produce correspondingly small changes in the measured length; however, conventional token-based prediction does not explicitly enforce this geometric relationship. Errors in individual digits or decimal placement can also substantially alter the predicted value, potentially compromising measurement precision. Furthermore, token-by-token generation for inferring numerical values can introduce cumulative errors, hindering precise diagnostic measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 一个核心挑战在于连续的测量目标与离散的基于词元的输出建模之间的不匹配，如图 1 所示。 临床上相关的量，如距离和直径，是连续变量，而自回归视觉语言模型通常将数值表示为词元序列，并通过分类式的下一词元预测来优化其似然。 尽管语言模型可以学习数值关系，但这一目标并未显式考虑数值误差的大小 [ 13 , 14 ] 。 例如，取决于分词器，数值 '10.1' 可能被分解为 '10'、'.' 和 '1'，并依次生成。 这样的表示没有显式保留数值的邻近性：相似的数值可能有不同的分词结果，且词元级别的预测误差并不直接反映对应数值之间的距离。 对于基于卡尺的测量，端点坐标的微小扰动应当产生测量长度上相应微小的变化；然而，传统的基于词元的预测并未显式地强制这一几何关系。 个别数字或小数点位置的错误也可能大幅改变预测值，从而可能损害测量精度。 此外，逐词元生成来推断数值会引入累积误差，阻碍精确的诊断测量。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we propose HAD-VLM , a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion vision-language model for prompt-conditioned quantitative US measurement. HAD-VLM combines autoregressive text generation with diffusion-based prediction of continuous measurements within a unified backbone. To connect numerical outputs with their spatial interpretation, we introduce a five-tuple measurement representation that couples caliper endpoint coordinates with the corresponding length, together with a coordinate-length consistency mechanism that encourages agreement between the predicted geometry and measurement value.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出 HAD-VLM，一种混合自回归-扩散视觉语言模型，用于基于提示条件的定量超声测量。 HAD-VLM 将自回归文本生成与基于扩散的连续测量预测结合在统一的主干网络中。 为将数值输出与其空间解释联系起来，我们引入了一种五元组测量表示，将卡尺端点坐标与相应长度相耦合，并配合一种坐标-长度一致性机制，促使预测的几何结构与测量值保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We introduce HAD-VLM, a unified framework that combines autoregressive text generation with continuous diffusion-based prediction for prompt-conditioned US measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 HAD-VLM，这是一个统一框架，将自回归文本生成与基于连续扩散的预测相结合，用于基于提示条件的超声测量。

paragraphs.en: We develop a five-tuple measurement representation and a coordinate-length consistency mechanism to couple anatomical localization with numerical estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种五元组测量表示和一种坐标-长度一致性机制，以将解剖定位与数值估计相耦合。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the framework across multiple US measurement tasks and analyze the effects of cross-task learning, continuous prediction, and the hybrid architecture on measurement accuracy and language performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多个美国测量任务上评估了该框架，并分析了跨任务学习、连续预测以及混合架构对测量精度和语言性能的影响。

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to introduce a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion formulation for quantitative US measurement, targeting precise numerical prediction while preserving the flexible language capabilities of VLMs within a single unified model. Specifically, we evaluate the framework in both ultrasound and X-ray imaging to examine its applicability across modalities. On ultrasound images, HAD-VALM performs four echocardiographic measurements specified through natural-language prompts, achieving measurement errors comparable in magnitude to previously reported inter-observer differences. For LVIDd and LVIDs, MAEs of 2.77 and 3.05 mm are numerically lower than the inter-observer differences of 2.97 and 3.60 mm reported in a separate study [ 15 ] . These findings support the potential of HAD-VLM for accurate, language-guided quantitative medical image assessment.

paragraphs.en: Deep learning approaches to quantitative US assessment commonly estimate anatomical landmarks, segment structures, or directly regress clinically relevant quantities [ 5 , 16 ] . In echocardiography, EchoNet-Dynamic combines ventricular segmentation with video-based estimation of cardiac function, enabling automated beat-to-beat assessment [ 6 ] . EchoNet-LVH further demonstrates automated measurement of ventricular dimensions and wall thickness for quantitative characterization of left ventricular hypertrophy [ 2 ] . In lung ultrasound, Lucassen et al. benchmark deep learning methods for B-line detection and introduce single-point localization of B-line origins to support interpretable quantification [ 17 ] . These studies establish strong task-specific approaches to reducing manual measurement effort and improving reproducibility. Such systems may support several related measurements, but their requested outputs are generally specified by a predefined task configuration. Our work investigates a language-conditioned formulation in which the measurement target is specified through a prompt and processed by a shared model. This formulation aims to facilitate joint learning across measurement tasks and provide a common interface for anatomical localization, numerical estimation, and associated textual outputs. Specialized measurement models remain important references for assessing the accuracy of this more flexible formulation.

paragraphs.en: Medical VLMs have expanded the scope of image analysis from fixed-label prediction to instruction-following and open-ended language generation. LLaVA-Med adapts a general-purpose vision-language assistant to biomedical images through domain-specific alignment and visual instruction tuning [ 10 ] . For echocardiographic video analysis, EchoAgent uses an LLM to orchestrate specialized vision tools for temporal localization, anatomical measurement, and guideline-based clinical interpretation [ 18 ] . In radiology, MAIRA-2 generates chest X-ray reports with spatial grounding of findings, linking textual descriptions to supporting image regions [ 11 ] . These developments illustrate the value of integrating visual evidence and language within a shared model. Quantitative measurement introduces an additional requirement: numerical outputs must be accurate and consistent with the underlying image geometry. Success in visual question answering or report generation does not, by itself, establish this capability. Studies of numerical representations show that language models can encode magnitude information, but numerical precision depends on the representation and training objective [ 13 ] . HAD-VLM addresses this requirement by explicitly modeling continuous measurement variables alongside autoregressive textual outputs and linking predicted lengths to their associated caliper coordinates.
paragraphs.zh: 医学视觉语言模型（VLM）将图像分析的范围从固定标签预测扩展到了指令跟随和开放式语言生成。 LLaVA-Med 通过领域特定的对齐和视觉指令微调，将通用的视觉语言助手适配到生物医学图像上 [ 10 ]。 在超声心动图视频分析方面，EchoAgent 使用大语言模型（LLM）来协调专门的视觉工具，以完成时间定位、解剖学测量以及基于指南的临床解读 [ 18 ]。 在放射学领域，MAIRA-2 生成带有空间定位的胸部 X 光报告，将文字描述与支持性的图像区域关联起来 [ 11 ]。 这些进展说明了在共享模型中整合视觉证据与语言的价值。 定量测量引入了一项额外的要求：数值输出必须准确，并且与底层图像几何结构保持一致。 在视觉问答或报告生成上取得成功，其本身并不能证明具备这种能力。 关于数值表示的研究表明，语言模型能够编码大小信息，但数值精度取决于表示方式和训练目标 [ 13 ]。 HAD-VLM 通过在自回归文本输出之外显式建模连续测量变量，并将预测的长度与其关联的卡尺坐标相链接，来满足这一要求。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have explored continuous prediction within language-conditioned architectures. Xue et al. proposed REO-VLM that augments a VLM with a regression branch for Earth observation and incorporates language-derived information into numerical estimation [ 14 ] . It demonstrates that generative and regression capabilities can coexist within a unified framework, providing a relevant precedent for quantitative vision-language modeling. Hybrid autoregressive-diffusion models offer another route to combining discrete and continuous outputs. Transfusion trains a shared Transformer using next-token prediction for text and diffusion for continuous image representations [ 19 ] . In robotics, HybridVLA integrates autoregressive and diffusion-based action prediction within a shared language-model backbone and combines their outputs for manipulation [ 20 ] . DiffusionVLA likewise combines autoregressive reasoning with diffusion-based action generation [ 21 ] . Together, these studies demonstrate that language-related processing and continuous generation can be learned within coordinated architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究已探索在语言条件化架构内进行连续预测。 Xue 等人提出了 REO-VLM，该方法在视觉语言模型（VLM）上增加一个用于对地观测的回归分支，并将源自语言的信息融入数值估计 [ 14 ] 。 它表明生成能力与回归能力可以在统一框架内共存，为定量化的视觉语言建模提供了相关先例。 混合自回归-扩散模型提供了结合离散与连续输出的另一条路径。 Transfusion 使用共享的 Transformer 进行训练，对文本采用下一个词预测，对连续图像表征采用扩散方法 [ 19 ] 。 在机器人领域，HybridVLA 在共享的语言模型骨干网络中集成了自回归与基于扩散的动作预测，并将二者的输出结合起来用于操作任务 [ 20 ] 。 DiffusionVLA 同样将自回归推理与基于扩散的动作生成相结合 [ 21 ] 。 总体而言，这些研究表明，与语言相关的处理和连续生成可以在相互协调的架构内一同学习。

paragraphs.en: HAD-VLM builds on this general modeling principle and adapts it to quantitative US measurement. Its task requires continuous predictions to agree with both the language-specified anatomical target and the geometry of the corresponding caliper placement. Accordingly, HAD-VLM couples endpoint coordinates and measurement length in a structured representation and introduces an explicit coordinate-length consistency mechanism. The distinction lies in this measurement-specific formulation and its integration with textual outputs. The benefit of diffusion over direct regression is assessed empirically through the corresponding ablation.
paragraphs.zh: HAD-VLM 基于这一通用建模原则，并将其适配到超声定量测量任务中。 其任务要求连续预测结果同时与语言指定的解剖目标以及相应卡尺放置的几何形态保持一致。 为此，HAD-VLM 将端点坐标与测量长度耦合在一种结构化表示中，并引入了显式的坐标-长度一致性机制。 其区别在于这种针对测量的公式化设计及其与文本输出的整合。 扩散模型相较于直接回归的优势通过相应的消融实验进行了实证评估。

paragraphs.en: To jointly generate “discrete” textual descriptions and “continuous” numerical values for US measurements, we propose HAD-VLM. In this model, each numerical value is predicted directly as a continuous variable via a diffusion-based process, with the VLM serving as the denoising backbone. As shown in Fig. 2 , the overall architecture comprises four main components: (a) a prompt-adapted vision encoder tailored to US data; (b) an MLP projector that aligns visual feature representations with the LLM token space; (c) an LLM augmented with a diffusion embedder and a diffusion head dedicated to numerical regression, and (d) a post-processing module that further refines the predicted measurements. Detailed descriptions of each component are provided below.
paragraphs.zh: 为了联合生成超声（US）测量的“离散”文本描述和“连续”数值，我们提出了 HAD-VLM。 在该模型中，每个数值通过基于扩散的过程直接作为连续变量进行预测，其中视觉语言模型（VLM）作为去噪骨干网络。 如图 2 所示，整体架构包含四个主要组件：(a) 针对超声数据定制的提示词适配视觉编码器；(b) 将视觉特征表示与 LLM 词元空间对齐的 MLP 投影器；(c) 增强了扩散嵌入器和专用于数值回归的扩散头的 LLM；以及 (d) 进一步精化预测测量的后处理模块。 下面提供各组件的详细描述。

paragraphs.en: To decouple numerical regression from autoregressive text decoding without extending the vocabulary, we use square brackets (“ [ ” and “ ] ”) as control tokens, thereby avoiding the need to train embeddings for newly introduced special tokens. When the model generates “ [ ”, it switches from text generation to diffusion-based regression; when “ ] ” is produced, autoregressive decoding resumes. Specifically, upon generating “ [ ”, we initialize x T ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 𝐈 ) x_{T}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I}) and perform fixed-step DDIM sampling (4 steps) to obtain the predicted value x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} . After regression, “ ] ” is manually appended to the sequence, and text decoding continues. This alternating decoding mechanism allows diffusion regression to condition on all preceding visual and textual tokens while avoiding the discretization of continuous numerical values. The final output, therefore, contains both structured textual descriptions and continuous measurement predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不扩展词表的情况下将数值回归与自回归文本解码解耦，我们使用方括号（“[”和“]”）作为控制标记，从而避免为新引入的特殊标记训练嵌入。 当模型生成“[”时，它会从文本生成切换到基于扩散的回归；当生成“]”时，自回归解码恢复。 具体而言，在生成“[”后，我们初始化 x T ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 𝐈 ) x_{T}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I)} 并执行固定步数的 DDIM 采样（4 步），以获得预测值 x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} 。 回归完成后，将“]”手动附加到序列中，文本解码继续进行。 这种交替解码机制使扩散回归能够以所有先前的视觉和文本标记为条件，同时避免对连续数值进行离散化。 因此，最终输出既包含结构化的文本描述，也包含连续的测量预测。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the hybrid inference procedure. At each measurement slot, multiple diffusion samples are independently generated and post-processed to obtain an ensemble estimate. The final length and a representative 5-tuple are stored in the measurement records, while the length is also inserted into the text sequence before autoregressive decoding resumes. This procedure preserves structured numerical outputs and makes the predicted measurements available as context for subsequent text generation.

paragraphs.en: We empoly a three-stage training strategy to progressively align visual-language representations, stabilize continuous numerical regression, and ultimately enable joint optimization:
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用三阶段训练策略，以逐步对齐视觉-语言表征、稳定连续数值回归，并最终实现联合优化：

paragraphs.en: Alignment : Optimize the visual prompts and the vision-language connector with ℒ ce \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ce}} while keeping CLIP and the LLM backbone frozen;
paragraphs.zh: 对齐（Alignment）：在保持 CLIP 和大语言模型主干冻结的同时，使用 ℒ ce \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ce}} 优化视觉提示（visual prompts）和视觉-语言连接器（vision-language connector）；

paragraphs.en: Regression : Activate the diffusion segment, optimize diffusion-related modules with ℒ diff \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{diff}} , and apply LoRA to the last four LLM layers;
paragraphs.zh: 回归：激活扩散段，使用 ℒ diff \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{diff}} 优化扩散相关模块，并对最后四层 LLM 层应用 LoRA；

paragraphs.en: Joint Training : Jointly optimize ℒ ce + ℒ diff \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{ce}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{diff}} over all trainable parameters to improve consistency between textual descriptions and numerical measurements.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the proposed method on EchoNet-LVH [ 2 ] , a publicly available ultrasound dataset for quantitative assessment of left ventricular structure. It contains approximately 12,000 B-mode echocardiography videos acquired from the parasternal long-axis view. The dataset provides annotated measurement endpoints in pixel coordinates for three key cardiac structures with phase labels distinguishing diastole and systole. paragraphs.en: We compare HAD-VLM with three baselines representing different numerical prediction strategies. VLM (Vicuna) uses Vicuna-7B-v1.5 to generate measurement values autoregressively as discrete text tokens. Fine-tuned Qwen3-VL [ 29 ] adopts the same token-based prediction strategy after fine-tuning on EchoNet-LVH , allowing us to examine the effect of using an alternative VLM backbone. VLM + MLP Regression replaces the diffusion-based prediction head with an MLP that directly regresses continuous measurement values, which shares the same settings of REO-VLM [ 14 ] . All methods are evaluated on the same test samples for each measurement task.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table I , HAD-VLM consistently outperforms the Vicuna-based autoregressive baseline across all four measurements. Similar improvements are observed for LVIDs and LVPWd, with MAE decreasing from 3.88 to 3.05 mm and from 1.86 to 1.16 mm, respectively. paragraphs.en: To further examine the roles of the backbone and numerical prediction strategy, we compare HAD-VLM with fine-tuned Qwen3-VL and a VLM equipped with a direct MLP regression head. Qwen3-VL generates numerical values autoregressively as discrete tokens. HAD-VLM achieves lower MAE across all four tasks, including 2.77 and 3.05 mm for LVIDd and LVIDs, compared with 3.71 and 3.82 mm for Qwen3-VL. Thus, adopting an alternative VLM backbone while retaining token-based numerical prediction does not match the accuracy of HAD-VLM under the evaluated settings. Direct MLP regression improves upon both autoregressive baselines, but HAD-VLM further reduces LVIDd and LVIDs MAE from 3.00 to 2.77 mm and from 3.42 to 3.05 mm, corresponding to reductions of 7.7% and 10.8%, respectively. These improvements, together with lower RMSE and higher R 2 R^{2} and Pearson correlation across all four tasks, favor the diffusion-based framework over direct regression in the evaluated configurations.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 illustrates the relationship between spatial localization and numerical accuracy. paragraphs.en: Removing visual prompt tuning ( w/o prompt tuning ) leads to the largest performance degradation among the evaluated variants, with deterioration across all four tasks and metrics. For IVSd, MAE increases from 1.36 to 1.93 mm, while R 2 R^{2} decreases from 0.56 to 0.11. The degradation is particularly pronounced for ventricular diameter measurements: LVIDd and LVIDs MAE increase from 2.77 to 5.07 mm and from 3.05 to 5.60 mm, respectively. These results highlight the importance of adapting the pretrained CLIP encoder to ultrasound images for accurate anatomical measurement.

paragraphs.en: Disabling both post-processing components ( w/o cons. w/o ens. ) also reduces performance. paragraphs.en: To examine the effect of joint training across measurement tasks, we compare a single multi-task HAD-VLM with four independently trained single-task models, each dedicated to one measurement. In the multi-task setting, the target measurement is specified through the user prompt, allowing all four tasks to be supported by a shared model. As shown in Table IV , multi-task training achieves lower MAE and RMSE and higher R 2 R^{2} and Pearson correlation across all four measurements. The largest improvements are observed for ventricular diameter estimation. For LVIDd, MAE decreases from 3.69 to 2.77 mm, corresponding to a 24.9% reduction, while RMSE decreases from 4.84 to 3.62 mm and R 2 R^{2} increases from 0.61 to 0.78. For LVIDs, MAE decreases from 3.69 to 3.05 mm, a 17.3% reduction, accompanied by an RMSE decrease from 4.89 to 4.00 mm and an increase in R 2 R^{2} from 0.66 to 0.77. Pearson correlation also improves from 0.80 to 0.89 for LVIDd and from 0.83 to 0.88 for LVIDs.

paragraphs.en: To assess the applicability of HAD-VLM beyond ultrasound, we evaluate superior endplate length measurement in cervical spine radiographs. We construct a dataset of 9,926 samples from the Cervical Spine X-ray Atlas ( CSXA ) V3.0 [ 31 ] by cropping C4 and C5 vertebral regions, with an 85:15 training–test split. As illustrated in Fig. 5 , the target measurement is defined as the Euclidean distance between the anterior and posterior endpoints of the superior endplate of the vertebral body. Since the images originate from heterogeneous sources and consistent pixel-to-physical-distance calibration is unavailable, measurements are evaluated in pixel space without applying physical-distance calibration; accordingly, all lengths and errors are reported in pixels.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估 HAD-VLM 在超声之外的应用性，我们在颈椎X光片上评估了椎体上终板长度的测量。 我们通过裁剪 C4 和 C5 椎体区域，从颈椎X光图谱（CSXA）V3.0 [31] 构建了一个包含 9,926 个样本的数据集，并按 85:15 的比例划分训练集与测试集。 如图 5 所示，目标测量被定义为椎体上终板前、后端点之间的欧氏距离。 由于这些图像来自异构来源且无法获得一致的像素到物理距离的标定，测量在像素空间中评估而不应用物理距离标定；因此，所有长度和误差均以像素为单位报告。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we investigate quantitative ultrasound measurement and move beyond task-specific regression networks by introducing a hybrid vision-language framework, HAD-VLM, that generates text autoregressively and predicts numerical measurements directly in continuous space via an embedded diffusion-based process. Experimental results demonstrate improved regression accuracy and robustness compared with the discrete token-based autoregressive baseline. A current limitation is that the framework focuses on linear measurements. Nevertheless, such measurements are widely applicable in clinical practice, including tumor size estimation, vessel diameter assessment, organ length measurement (e.g., kidney length), myocardial wall thickness evaluation, etc. Extending the proposed framework to more complex geometric or area-based measurements is a promising direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: Beyond ultrasound, the proposed hybrid autoregressive-diffusion formulation can potentially apply to other imaging modalities, such as X-ray, CT, and MRI. Another promising direction is to incorporate higher-quality report supervision that follows a “qualitative-to-quantitative” workflow, where anatomical structures and boundary characteristics are described before numerical measurements are reported. Such structured supervision may provide meaningful anatomical priors, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of quantitative prediction.

paragraphs.en: We presented HAD-VLM, a unified vision-language framework for prompt-conditioned quantitative ultrasound measurement that combines autoregressive text generation with diffusion-based continuous prediction. A five-tuple representation couples caliper endpoint coordinates with measurement length, while a post-processing strategy comprising coordinate-length consistency and ensemble prediction further refines the estimates. On four EchoNet-LVH measurement tasks, HAD-VLM achieved MAEs of 1.36, 2.77, 3.05, and 1.16 mm for IVSd, LVIDd, LVIDs, and LVPWd, respectively, outperforming both autoregressive baselines and direct MLP regression across all evaluated metrics. Ablation experiments supported the contributions of ultrasound-specific visual adaptation and post-processing, while multi-task training improved performance over independently trained single-task models. Medical question answering performance was preserved on the evaluated benchmark. An additional evaluation of cervical vertebral superior endplate length measurement reduced MAE from 11.4 to 6.7 pixels, providing preliminary evidence of applicability beyond ultrasound. These findings support integrating language generation and continuous numerical prediction within a shared architecture to enable flexible, anatomically grounded measurement. HAD-VLM offers a foundation for language-guided measurement assistance and the incorporation of quantitative image findings into clinical reporting workflows. Future work will investigate validation across institutions and imaging conditions, measurement uncertainty estimation, and integration into comprehensive report generation.
